title: Pre-series Contender Configuration Modal allowing the player to choose their Geometric Crest palette, select who claims the opening turn (`Initiator First` vs `Arbiter First` vs `Alternating`), and select the Arbiter's cognitive tier (*Tier I: Opportunist*, *Tier II: Tactical Blocker*, *Tier III: Perfect Minimax Oracle*).
summary: Implement an interactive pre-series tactical modal initializing Arbiter cognitive tier, player sigil palette, and opening turn precedence.
technical_specification: Maintain `state.config = { open: boolean, palette: 0|1, firstTurn: 'PLAYER'|'ARBITER'|'ALTERNATING', tier: 1|2|3, roundCount: number }`. When `state.config.open` is true, render diegetic obsidian modal over center lattice (`x: 220, y: 130, w: 360, h: 360`). Map pointer clicks and key inputs (`1-3` for tier, `P` for palette toggle, `T` for turn mode, `SPACE`/`ENTER` to lock). Upon confirmation, set `state.config.open = false`, set `state.arbiterTier = config.tier`, set active contender `state.activeContender = (config.firstTurn === 'ALTERNATING' ? (config.roundCount % 2 === 0 ? 1 : 2) : (config.firstTurn === 'PLAYER' ? 1 : 2))`, and dispatch `CONFIG_COMMITTED`.
acceptance_criteria: Modal renders without DOM overlays using native canvas drawing in obsidian/gold styling.
Selecting Tier I, II, or III cleanly updates `state.arbiterTier` before turn 1 starts.
Palette toggles between Crimson/Gold and Cyan/Violet, stored in `state.activePalette`.
